The corrected sheet USGS_SDG_open_data_set_corrected.xlsx (2026-10-13, D79 and D80: 16 titles, 9 years, 18 page counts, 5 direct PDF URLs and 2 TRL assessment units corrected from the verified PDFs, each changed cell highlighted with a 'Was: ...' comment, and a status column naming the case of every row or why it was left out) matches this manifest.
licence_note: USGS-authored or produced information is in the U.S. public domain and may be used without restriction; credit is requested (for example 'Credit: U.S. Geological Survey'; cite each report by its suggested citation or DOI). Caveat: not all material in USGS publications is public domain. 93 of the 100 PDFs (the 99 cases and USGS-SDG-067) state that the product 'may contain copyrighted materials as noted in the text' and that permission to reproduce copyrighted items must be secured from the copyright owner. Third-party items found by text search include Esri basemaps, Google Earth and Maxar imagery, National Geographic basemaps, CNES/SPOT imagery, Oregon ShoreZone photographs and an individually credited photograph. Distribute the PDFs unmodified with their USGS URLs and SHA-256 (or let teams fetch them from pubs.usgs.gov), do not reuse such figures separately, and do not use the USGS logo. Sources: https://www.usgs.gov/information-policies-and-instructions/copyrights-and-credits (the page could not be reached on 2026-10-13; its content was confirmed through search results), https://pubs.usgs.gov/documentation/faq (reviewed 2026-10-13).
reference_label_meaning: reference_labels.estimated_trl and reference_labels.rationale are the organizer's estimates from the sheet (columns Estimated TRL and TRL rationale). They are not expert labels per checklist criterion, they carry no evidence pages, and they are not the labels of the hidden evaluation cases. Use them to sanity-check a module, not as ground truth.
inclusion_rule: A case is included only if its PDF opens with pypdf 6.19.0 without a password, has at most 300 pages and at most 52,428,800 bytes (D77). Every case has one PDF document.

measured_with.text_layer_rule: text_layer is true when at least half of all pages and at least half of the sampled pages (first 5 pages and 5 later pages spread over the document) yield 100 or more non-whitespace characters with pypdf extract_text()

assessment_target_type_mapping: type follows the TRL assessment unit, not the sheet category. 'technology': models, model applications, software, analysis workflows, survey and mapping methods, map libraries and data products (92 cases). 'system': deployed observation, monitoring, warning or data-delivery arrangements made of field instruments or structures operated in the field (cases 6, 33, 89, 90, 91, 97 and 98; 97 is installed living-shoreline oyster-castle structures). 'component' and 'subsystem' are not used. Borderline: 27 (GNSS survey for an observation network) is 'technology' because the unit is a survey method; 50 (an 'inundation-map system') is 'technology' because it is a map library.
intended_application_rule: '<application phrase for the sheet category> for <SDG target text> (SDG target <n>)'; the phrase restates the category as an application (for example 'Water-quality treatment' -> 'Water-quality monitoring and constituent-load estimation', because both reports are about monitoring and surrogate models, not treatment).

case_template.schema_version: the server's schema_version (GET /v1/package); tools/get_public_cases.py takes it from the kit configuration (--config) or --schema-version
case_template.request_id: PUBLIC-<case_id> (tools/get_public_cases.py); send a fresh request_id for every run
case_template.document_file: <case_id>.pdf in the folder given to tools/get_public_cases.py --dir; the PDFs are not part of the kit
